# psi

## Overview
Hand-written PSI interfaces and reference contributors (DartFile, DartComponent, PubspecYamlReferenceContributor).

## Interface
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.psi.DartFile
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.psi.DartComponent
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.psi.PubspecYamlReferenceContributor
- ./impl/ABOUT.md

## Invariants
- Defines high-level PSI interfaces for Dart components and pubspec.yaml references.

## Side Effects
- Resolves file and package references.
